message.content:
I'll search for the definition of "monogamous" for you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>monogamous definition meaning</query>

Based on my search, **monogamous** is an adjective with two main meanings:

1. **In relationships/marriage**: Having only one romantic or sexual partner at a time; practicing or being committed to a relationship with only one person. This can refer to being married to one person at a time, or being in an exclusive romantic/sexual relationship with one partner.

2. **In biology/zoology**: Mating with or having only one partner during a breeding season or for life. Some animal species are monogamous, forming pair bonds with a single mate.

The noun form is **monogamy**, and the opposite is **polygamous/polygamy** (having multiple partners/spouses) or **non-monogamous**.

Common uses:
- "They decided to be monogamous after dating for a few months."
- "Swans are known to be monogamous birds, often mating for life."

Sources:
1. https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/monogamous
2. https://www.dictionary.com/browse/monogamous
3. https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/monogamous
